name: Claude-Mem
summary: Persistent memory for coding agents: captures what a session did, compresses it and injects relevant context into later sessions.
description: A memory layer for coding agents: 5 lifecycle hooks capture sessions, observations are compressed and stored in SQLite with FTS5 and hybrid Chroma vector search, and relevant context is injected into future sessions. Agents query it through 4 MCP tools with a token-efficient 3-layer workflow, a web viewer shows the memory stream, and it installs for Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, OpenClaw and other agents (also published on npm as claude-mem).
contains: 5 lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd)
SQLite storage with FTS5 search and hybrid Chroma vector search
4 MCP search tools with a 3-layer workflow (~10x token savings)
web viewer UI and cloud sync
installs via npx claude-mem install for Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw
